| description = A target for the [[Cleric Epic Quest]] spawned by giving a specific [[a seeker]] (330, 40, 30) a [[Coral Statue of Tarew]]. He is KOS.

Casts [[Complete Heal]], [[Reckoning]], [[Annul Magic]], and [[Word Divine]]; the last one is a PBAE <del>that can affect mobs around the priest causing them to attack him which could result in the quest being failed</del>, and so he is often fought away from mobs usually at the zoneline.

He does not have particularly impressive resists, but he does summon. This fight is easy with a small group of 60s.

Will despawn if not engaged within 10 minutes. Will not despawn while engaged ''(2/13/13 patch)''. Unfearable?

EDIT 8/289/2024: The placeholder is on a six minute respawn timer.  We fought him inside the room both times with one full group and a single 60 druid.  We had high DPS on the first fight and took him down in less than a minute and before he cast his PBAoE.  The second fight we were short our rogue and the 60 druid, and he got one PBAoE off.  The two other mobs in the room agro'd on us.  The adds are green at 51 and they went down quickly, although we took faction hits from them.  Both adds dropped Darkwood Staffs, Robe to the Keeper, and one dropped Human Blood.
